verdict.rationale: Gecko's docs say every finding includes a suggested patch. A "Request fix" button opens a gecko/* pull request with the patch applied, or Gecko can commit the fix to an existing PR's head branch. After you merge, Gecko rechecks and marks the finding "Fix verified", which covers the draft–review–merge loop end to end. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the quality or correctness of Gecko's generated fix PRs.
